full_judgment: 23. The plaintiffs case is that they were all along in possession of the suit land but they were dispossessed by the defendants during pendency of the suit on 24th Sraban, 1389 BS and thereafter the plaintiffs by way of amendment of the plaint, prayed for recovery of khas possession. Both the courts below have concurrently held that the plaintiffs have failed to prove their possession before the alleged date of dispossession on 24th Sraban, 1389 BS and this concurrent findings on the possession and dispossession of the plaintiffs by the courts below specially by the court of appeal below which is the last court of fact cannot be disturbed by this court in exercise of revisional jurisdiction when there is no allegation of misreading and non-reading of the evidence.
